nuqs useQueryState (string).description:
Sync one string state with a URL query parameter; the value is null when the parameter is absent. Requires useQueryState from nuqs and a NuqsAdapter above this component.

将一个字符串状态与 URL 查询参数同步，参数不存在时值为 null；需要从 nuqs 导入 useQueryState，且上层存在 NuqsAdapter。

nuqs useQueryState (parsed with default).description:
Sync a parsed state with a URL query parameter. A default makes the value non-nullable. Requires useQueryState and a parser from nuqs, plus a NuqsAdapter above this component.

将解析后的状态与 URL 查询参数同步；提供默认值后该值不再可能为 null。需要从 nuqs 导入 useQueryState 与对应 parser，且上层存在 NuqsAdapter。

nuqs useQueryStates (multiple keys).description:
Read and write several URL query parameters as one object, updating them in a single history entry. Requires useQueryStates and parsers from nuqs, plus a NuqsAdapter above this component.

把多个 URL 查询参数作为一个对象读写，并合并为单条历史记录；需要从 nuqs 导入 useQueryStates 与对应 parser，且上层存在 NuqsAdapter。

nuqs parseAsStringLiteral.description:
Restrict a query parameter to a fixed set of strings, rejecting anything else. Requires parseAsStringLiteral from nuqs.

把查询参数限定在固定的字符串集合内，其余取值一律拒绝；需要从 nuqs 导入 parseAsStringLiteral。

nuqs parseAsArrayOf.description:
Parse a delimited query parameter into an array. Requires parseAsArrayOf and an item parser from nuqs.

把带分隔符的查询参数解析为数组；需要从 nuqs 导入 parseAsArrayOf 及元素 parser。

nuqs setter options (history and shallow.description:
Write a query parameter with an explicit history entry, and let the server see the change. The setter returns a promise resolving to the new search params. Requires an existing nuqs setter.

写入查询参数时显式产生历史记录，并让服务端感知该变化；setter 返回解析为新 search params 的 promise。需要已有的 nuqs setter。

nuqs NuqsAdapter (JavaScript).description:
Provide the adapter that nuqs 2 requires above any component using its hooks. Swap the import for the adapter matching your router, such as nuqs/adapters/next/app or nuqs/adapters/react-router/v7.

提供 nuqs 2 必需的适配器，需置于所有使用其 Hook 的组件之上；按所用路由改导入路径，例如 nuqs/adapters/next/app 或 nuqs/adapters/react-router/v7。

Provide the adapter that nuqs 2 requires above any component using its hooks. Swap the import for the adapter matching your router, such as nuqs/adapters/next/app or nuqs/adapters/react-router/v7.
